create_online_model_init: create query features for tracking points using the TAPIR model and preprocessed frames
run_online_model_predict: run online point tracking to compute trajectories and occlusion predictions from frames and causal context
test_postprocess_occlusions: test occlusion postprocessing to determine visible points from occlusion and uncertainty outputs
build_preprocess_frames: build a frame preprocessing function that normalizes pixel values from [0,255] to [-1,1]
summarize_get_frame: summarize the frame extraction function that reads and crops video frames to square aspect ratio
